World

Trump meets Venezuela’s Delcy Rodriguez for the first time since Maduro’s capture

The meeting came during Rodriguez's first trip to the US since taking office. She is set to address the General Assembly Wednesday afternoon.

Reuters

23 September, 2026 09:43 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

FILE PHOTO: Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodriguez attends the signing of an agreement to re-establish relations with Paraguay, at Miraflores Palace in Caracas, Venezuela, September 19, 2026. REUTERS/Leonardo Fernandez Viloria/File Photo

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New York: US President Donald Trump met Venezuela’s interim President Delcy Rodriguez late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, their first meeting since American forces captured then-President Nicolas Maduro in a January raid.

The Venezuelan delegation, which includes the vice president of economy, the oil minister and officials from state oil company PDVSA, is focused on making the country look “investable,” two people close to the delegation told Reuters.

The pull-aside meeting during a reception Trump hosted during the UN General Assembly came during Rodriguez’s first trip to the US since taking office. She is set to address the General Assembly on Wednesday afternoon.

Show Full Article

A White House official said the meeting with Rodriguez included President Trump, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, and Stephen Miller, assistant to the president and deputy chief of staff for policy.

Trump has built a working relationship with Rodriguez, who served as Maduro’s vice president. But critics say Washington has sidelined the opposition led by Maria Corina Machado, dropping demands for free elections in favor of oil and investment deals with the interim government. A small group of Venezuelans protested in New York on Tuesday, calling for elections.

In his speech to the General Assembly on Tuesday morning, Trump called Maduro an “outlaw dictator,” said hundreds of political prisoners had been freed since his capture and held up the raid as proof the US would use its “unmatched military might” to protect its interests in the Western Hemisphere.

“To the victor belong the spoils,” he said, calling an oil deal his administration signed with Caracas last month “perhaps the biggest deal ever made.” Trump has said he wants $100 billion in investment to flow into Venezuela’s oil industry.

Rodriguez arrived in New York on Monday with a delegation that has been holding talks on energy, mining and debt with US officials, multilateral lenders and companies, according to sources. The head of the Inter-American Development Bank is working to secure approval for a $2.5 billion loan for Venezuela but has faced pushback from some members of the lender’s board.

DEMONSTRATORS DEMAND FREE ELECTIONS

Earlier on Tuesday, more than 50 protesters gathered outside the UN to protest Rodriguez’s presence, waving Venezuelan flags and carrying signs reading “No Vote No Oil” and “New Face, Same Regime.” Many said they wanted Trump to push for free elections in the South American country.

The protesters sang the Venezuelan national anthem and chanted “Delcy, I swear, you’re going to Brooklyn with Maduro” — a reference to the federal jail in the New York City borough of Brooklyn, just across the East River from the UN, where her predecessor is being held pending trial on drug trafficking charges.

“On one hand, it’s outrageous to see part of the regime meeting with the authorities of this country’s current government, but there’s also no doubt that thanks to this government, today we are one step closer to freedom,” said Miguel Eduardo Martinez, a 34-year-old social media manager who moved from Caracas in 2017.

“Delcy Rodriguez wasn’t born on January 3, 2026. Delcy Rodriguez has been with the Chavista dictatorship for more than 20 years. She has been complicit,” said Cesar Coello, who carried a sign depicting Rodriguez in an orange jumpsuit.

Chavismo is the political movement founded by the late Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez.

Coello said he hoped Trump and Rodriguez would discuss holding elections soon.

(Reporting by Luc Cohen and Marianna Parraga in New York; Additional reporting by Gram Slattery, Writing by Nathan Crooks; Editing by Sanjeev Miglani and Stephen Coates)

item.title: Novo Nordisk open to direct New York listing, CEO Doustdar tells FT
item.description: Novo Nordisk is open to considering a direct New York Stock Exchange listing, replacing the American depositary receipts through which US investors currently trade its shares, CEO Mike Doustdar told the Financial Times in an interview published on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) is open to considering a direct New York Stock Exchange listing, replacing the American depositary receipts through which US investors currently trade its shares, CEO Mike Doustdar told the Financial Times in an interview published on Wednesday. The US accounts for more than half of Novo's revenue and the bulk of sales of its diabetes and obesity drugs, but the Danish drugmaker is under pressure to regain momentum in the weight-loss market against rival Eli Lilly (LLY.N) . "I clearly do see some advantages with that," Doustdar told the newspaper when asked whether Novo would consider a direct listing on the New York Stock Exchange. "Our investor community to a larger extent has shifted over the last 20 years (outside of) Scandinavia, and we are increasingly speaking to investors in the US. . . in addition to (our long-term investors)," Doustdar added. Doustdar said the idea of a direct US listing had been discussed over the past decade, but there had been no "active dialogue or discussions" about it since he became CEO [USN:L8N3SD04B TEXT:"last year."] "I’m a type who doesn’t start with a 'no' typically; I start with 'maybe. "Can you give me the pros and the cons of that and let’s have a dialogue and discussions about it," Doustdar also said, though he stressed that the company is not currently exploring the idea. Novo, which is primarily listed in Copenhagen, rode a wave of demand after launching weight-loss drug Wegovy in 2021, helping it become Europe's most valuable listed firm in 2023 with a market value of more than $600 billion. Novo Nordisk didn't immediately respond to a Reuters request to comment outside regular business hours. Since then, however, Novo's shares have fallen more than 70% since its peak, while Lilly's have risen. Sales of Lilly's rival weight-loss treatment, Zepbound, are expected to exceed Wegovy sales this year by more than $7 billion, according to LSEG data.

FAST

PHNOM PENH: Cambodia’s prime minister said the country would not be a haven for transnational scam syndicates as he opened a global conference on cyberfraud on Wednesday (Sep 23), where the government is keen to showcase its crackdown on the multibillion-dollar scam industry. "Cambodia will never be a safe haven for online scams," Prime Minister Hun Manet said in an opening speech in Phnom Penh, where delegates from more than a dozen countries, including the United States and China, have gathered. "Cambodia will not allow criminal syndicates to undermine our country's progress and the livelihood of over 17 million Cambodian people," he said, adding that the country supported more international cooperation, including real-time intelligence sharing. The Cambodian authorities say they have eradicated industrial-scale scam compounds, a claim met with scepticism by some analysts who say raids have left high-level figures unscathed.

The conference represents a "growing openness to cooperate", said Delphine Schantz, regional representative of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime. “But it is clear that more can and needs to be done, both at national levels and in terms of international cooperation,” she said, calling for a joint understanding of key trends and coherent regulatory frameworks including investment in digital evidence collection. The country, along with other Southeast Asian nations, emerged in recent years as a hub for the transnational cyberscam industry, with mostly Chinese-led criminal gangs operating compounds where trafficking victims are detained and coerced into carrying out romance scams, police-impersonation fraud and other schemes. On Monday and Tuesday, reporters toured sprawling centres shuttered by the government – one housing as many as 20,000 workers. They also viewed materials seized by police, including fake FBI and Chinese police badges used in impersonation schemes. Under pressure from countries including the US, which estimates that Americans lost more than US$10 billion to scammers operating in the region in 2024 alone, Cambodia says it has raided hundreds of compounds and deported hundreds of thousands of people over the past year. But analysts and opposition figures say the raids have left politically connected figures who allegedly protected the networks untouched, while criminal groups have adapted by breaking into smaller units and moving operations overseas. The credibility of the crackdown "will depend on whether the Cambodian state is willing to investigate all credible allegations, regardless of wealth, influence or official position", Mu Sochua, an exiled opposition politician, said in a statement.

item.title: ベネズエラ暫定大統領、トランプ氏と短時間会談 国連本部前で抗議活動も
item.description:
Luc Cohen Marianna Parraga
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Luc Cohen　Marianna Parraga

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２２日、国連総会が開かれている米ニューヨークでベネズエラのロドリゲス暫定大統領と会談した。ロドリゲス氏は、暫定大統領就任後初の米国訪問。今年１月の米軍によるマドゥロ大統領の身柄拘束後、初の首脳会談となった。ロドリゲス氏は２３日午後に国連総会で演説する予定。

トランプ氏は、マドゥロ政権下で副大統領を務めたロドリゲス氏と実務的な関係を築いている。会談は、トランプ氏が主催したレセプションで短時間行われた。ホワイトハウス当局者によると、会談にはトランプ氏のほか、ルビオ国務長官、ベセント財務長官、ワイルズ大統領首席補佐官、ミラー大統領補佐官兼政策担当副首席補佐官が出席した。

トランプ氏は２２日午前に国連総会で行った演説で、マドゥロ氏を「無法な独裁者」と呼び、同氏拘束後に数百人の政治犯が釈放されたと述べた。

ロドリゲス氏は、経済担当副大統領、石油相、国営石油会社ＰＤＶＳＡの幹部らで構成する代表団を率いて２１日にニューヨーク入りした。エネルギー、鉱業、債務を巡り、米政府当局者や国際金融機関、企業と協議する予定。米州開発銀行（ＩＤＢ）の総裁は、ベネズエラ向け２５億ドルの融資承認を取り付けようとしているが、理事会の一部メンバーから反発を受けている。

２２日には、国連本部前に５０人以上のベネズエラ人が集まり、ロドリゲス氏の総会出席に抗議するとともに、自由な選挙実施を訴えた。

item.title: Mets rally past Rangers, tighten AL West race
item.description: Francisco Alvarez laced a go-ahead two-run double in the sixth, then scored an insurance run on an unusual sacrifice fly Tuesday night for the visiting New York Mets, who damaged the Texas Rangers' playoff hopes with a 6-3 win in the opener of a three-game interleague series in Arlington.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Francisco Alvarez laced a go-ahead two-run double in the sixth, then scored an insurance run on an unusual sacrifice fly Tuesday night for the visiting New York Mets, who damaged the Texas Rangers' playoff hopes with a 6-3 win in the opener of a three-game interleague series in Arlington. Juan Soto had an RBI single in the third, and Carson Benge capped the scoring with a run-scoring double in the seventh for the Mets (72-85). The club won hours after removing the interim tag from manager Andy Green and signing him to a three-year extension. Green is 38-38 since taking over for Carlos Mendoza on June 26. Benge also scored in the fourth when ex-Mets outfielder Brandon Nimmo misplayed Alvarez's fly ball to right. Josh Jung had an RBI double in the third, and Elias Diaz and Wyatt Langford lofted sacrifice flies in the fourth for the Rangers (78-79), who entered Tuesday with a one-game lead over the Houston Astros in the AL West. The Astros won the season series between the teams 9-4, which means the Rangers must win the AL West outright to earn the division crown. The sacrifice flies by Diaz and Langford gave the Rangers their lone lead against Sean Manaea before the Mets rallied against Nathan Eovaldi (11-10). Brett Baty led off with a double and Benge walked before Baty was forced at third on Marcus Semien's grounder. Alvarez followed with his two-run double and advanced to third on A.J. Ewing's single. Luis Torrens followed with a foul out to first baseman Jake Burger in shallow right field. But Burger made the catch with his back to the plate and double-clutched as Alvarez tagged up, raced home and slid in ahead of the tag by Diaz. Alvarez, Soto and Benge each had two hits, while Ewing collected his 25th stolen base of the season, breaking Mookie Wilson's record for stolen bases by a Mets rookie. Manaea (6-7) allowed three runs (two earned) on three hits and two walks, striking out nine over six innings. Nate Lavender and Dedniel Nunez each threw a perfect inning, and Kodai Senga notched his eighth save with a hitless ninth. Nimmo, playing against the Mets for the first time since he was traded for Semien last November, recorded two hits. Rangers starter MacKenzie Gore gave up two runs (one earned) on four hits and one walk while striking out two over five innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: ホルムズ海峡通過船、22日は3隻＝海運データ
item.description: [シンガポール ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シンガポール ２３日 ロイター] - ２３日に発表された海運データ（速報値）によると、２２日にホルムズ海峡を通過したコモディティー（商品）輸送船は３隻となり、前日の４隻から減少し、１０日移動平均の約１５隻を下回った。

航行中にトランスポンダー（船舶自動識別装置）をオフにしている船舶もあるため、この数字は変動する可能性がある。

船舶追跡サービスのケプラーのデータによると、０２００ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前１１時）時点で、３隻はいずれも海峡を出る方向に進んでいた。うち１隻はパナマックス型タンカーだった。

一方、ケプラーとＬＳＥＧのデータによると、１９日に海峡外で最後に確認されていたバラスト（空荷）状態の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）タンカー「アル・マフヤール」が、２２日に海峡内で再び確認された。

紅海側の要衝バベルマンデブ海峡を通過した商品輸送船は２２隻だった。１４隻が紅海方面へ、８隻がアデン湾方面へ向かっていた。

パナマックス型タンカー５隻、スープラマックス型６隻、アフラマックス型４隻、スエズマックス型１隻、超大型原油タンカー（ＶＬＣＣ）１隻などが含まれる。

過去１０日間に同海峡を通航した船舶は平均で約２６隻だった。

item.title: 英首相、ＡＩの国際基準策定主導と表明 国連演説
item.description:
Elizabeth Piper
［国連 ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elizabeth Piper

［国連　２２日　ロイター］ - バーナム英首相は２２日、米ニューヨークの国連本部で開かれている国連総会で初の一般討論演説を行い、人工知能（ＡＩ）が安全対策を上回る速さで進化し、国家安全保障上のリスクが増大していると指摘し、ＡＩの国際基準策定に向けた取り組みを英国が主導する用意があると表明した。

この１０年で７人目の首相となるバーナム氏は、英国の外交的地位を再構築し、国際舞台で役割を担うための取り組みの柱にＡＩを据えた。米国との緊密な関係、改善しつつある欧州連合（ＥＵ）との関係、中国やインドとの良好な関係を挙げて、英国を「誠実な仲介者」と位置付け、主導的な役割を果たす考えを示した。

同氏はかねて、ＡＩを巡って「破滅論者」になるのではなく、ＡＩがもたらし得る大きな恩恵を追求する一方、安全対策が技術の進歩に追い付かないリスクや、敵対勢力による情報戦への悪用といった危険性を明確に認識する必要があると述べている。

演説では「われわれは皆、警告を耳にしてきた。それを真摯に受け止めなければならない」とし、「人々がどれほど懸念しているかは承知している。今こそ、この局面に立ち向かわなければならない」と述べた。

「ロシアの政府機関は、利用可能なあらゆる手段を使い、虚偽や偽情報を広め、人々の不安をあおってきた」と指摘し、「彼らは、ボットや偽サイトを使った。新聞記事を偽造した。大学や英ＢＢＣを含む英国の２８組織のブランドを偽装した。極右の主張を増幅させた。２０１９年の総選挙に干渉しようとした証拠もある」とした。

ＡＩに関する根本的な判断はテクノロジー企業に委ねるのではなく、選挙で選ばれた政府が下すべきだと指摘。２７年の２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）議長国として、ＡＩを主要課題に据える方針を示した。

「備えを強化するために必要な透明性と情報へのアクセスを確保し、ＡＩ開発の安全を確保するため、単一の世界的な原則と基準の合意を目指す」と述べた。

英国には世界をリードするＡＩ安全保障研究所があり、ＡＩの安全性を巡り米国や主要研究機関と緊密に連携していると説明。ただ、さらに踏み込む必要があるとした。

その上で、国家情報防衛センターを新設すると発表した。同センターは、敵対国による情報攻撃の検知、発信元の特定および妨害、英国の利益を損なうディープフェイクの特定を担う。

首相府によると、政府当局者はＡＩ業界の首脳らとの協議で、英国の備えと強靱（きょうじん）性を高めるため、新たな最先端モデルについて完全な情報開示を期待していることを明確に伝えた。

item.title: Venezuelan opposition leader Machado fails in return attempts as Rodriguez meets Trump
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado made three unsuccessful bids to return to Venezuela in recent hours, her team and media said on Tuesday, as interim President Delcy Rodriguez met US President Donald Trump in New York.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado made three unsuccessful bids to return to Venezuela in recent hours, her team and media said on Tuesday, as interim President Delcy Rodriguez met US President Donald Trump in New York. The flurry of activity comes amid high-stakes diplomacy at the United Nations General Assembly, where Trump held [USN:L6N45E138 TEXT:"his first meeting"] with Rodriguez since US forces captured then-President Nicolas Maduro during a raid in January. Machado adviser Pedro Urruchurtu said on social media the latest sea and air attempts were among seven failed efforts to return since she clandestinely left Venezuela nine months ago, as reported by Spanish newspaper ABC. The remarks were later confirmed by a spokesperson for Machado, who has not publicly commented on the failed attempts. The US State Department did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Following the June earthquakes in Venezuela, US officials privately urged Machado to postpone her return and [USN:L1N42Y0X4 TEXT:"opposed her efforts"] to re-enter the country, people familiar with the matter said. Machado, a Nobel Peace Prize laureate, has been in exile since late last year following a period in hiding after the contested 2024 election. Her arrival remains a point of contention, despite having repeatedly vowed to return after Maduro's ouster and two major earthquakes. Newspaper ABC did not give details on who blocked the attempts by sea and air.

item.title: 米ロ外相が23日会談へ、国連総会に合わせＮＹで
item.description:
Kanishka Singh
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米国務省は２２日、ルビオ国務長官が２３日午前にニューヨークでロシアのラブロフ外相と会談すると発表した。

ラブロフ氏は２６日に国連総会で演説を行う。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２２日、ニューヨークの国連本部でトランプ米大統領と会談し、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争を終結させる方策について協議した。ゼレンスキー氏は会談後、エネルギー施設を対象とした停戦などについて話し合ったと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は先週、ウクライナとロシアがエネルギー関連施設への攻撃を控えることで合意したと述べた。しかし、翌日にはロシアがウクライナの首都キーウのガソリンスタンドを攻撃し、ウクライナもロシアの製油所を爆撃した。

ラブロフ氏は先週、和平協議が行われる場合もロシアはその間、ウクライナでの戦闘を停止しないと述べた。

item.title: イラン、カタール仲介で米に条件伝達 全戦線での戦闘終結など＝ＩＲＮＡ
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - イランは、ニューヨークでカタールの仲介を通じて米国と接触し、全戦線での戦闘終結や米国の「侵略行為」の停止などの条件を伝えた。イラン外務省のバガイ報道官が国営イラン通信
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２３日 ロイター] - イランは、ニューヨークでカタールの仲介を通じて米国と接触し、全戦線での戦闘終結や米国の「侵略行為」の停止などの条件を伝えた。イラン外務省のバガイ報道官が国営イラン通信 （ＩＲＮＡ）に明らかにした。

ＩＲＮＡによると、バガイ氏は、イランの条件には海上封鎖と経済戦争の終結、イラン資産の凍結解除も含まれると述べた。

item.title: 米韓首脳が会談、対米戦略的投資計画の進展を歓迎＝韓国大統領府
item.description:
Kyu-seok Shim
[ソウル ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kyu-seok Shim

[ソウル ２３日 ロイター] - 韓国大統領府は２３日、李在明大統領とトランプ米大統領が国連総会の合間に３０分間会談し、戦略的投資プロジェクトに関する協議において「著しい進展」があったことを歓迎したと発表した。

会談に先立ち、韓国の産業通商資源省は２２日、国会議員らに対し、米国との３５００億ドル規模の投資合意に基づく事業計画について説明を行っていた。

韓国の魏聖洛国家安保室長は「両首脳は、両国間の戦略的投資プロジェクトに関する協議で著しい進展があったことを歓迎した」と記者会見で述べた。

魏氏は、昨年１１月の首脳会談後に発表された共同声明に基づき、両首脳は核燃料再処理、原子力潜水艦、造船、および戦時作戦指揮権の米国から韓国への移管などの問題について、協力を深化させ、協議を継続することで合意したと明らかにした。

同氏はまた、トランプ大統領は北朝鮮との対話に臨む意思を改めて表明し、両首脳は平和プロセスの推進に向け、緊密な連携を維持することで合意したと語った。

同氏はさらに、李大統領は２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談が韓中関係を含む地域の情勢にとって重要だとし、会談の成功への期待を表明したと述べた。

ホワイトハウスは米韓首脳会談について直ちにコメントしなかった。

＜北朝鮮問題やゴルフ巡り協議＞

李氏は国連総会で演説し、北朝鮮との対話再開に向けた取り組みを支持し、恒久的な平和の枠組み構築に向けて努力する意向を示すとともに、こうした取り組みへの国際的な支持を広く求めていく方針を表明した。

大統領府高官が韓国メディアに明らかにしたところによると、李氏はまた、北朝鮮との対話促進を後押しするようトランプ氏に期待を示し、トランプ氏はこれに応じる意向を示したという。トランプ氏は北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記と良好な関係を維持しているとも述べたが、現時点で具体的な接触が行われている兆候はないという。

同高官は、韓国による対米投資を巡る協議の進展が、当初開催が見込まれていなかった今回の首脳会談実現への道を開いたと述べた。

両首脳は交渉について説明を受け、進展を歓迎したが、投資計画の詳細やその発表方法についてはなお協議が続いているという。

また、トランプ氏は李氏とゴルフをする可能性に言及し、李氏は１２月にマイアミで開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議の合間に一緒にプレーできると提案したという。

item.title: Rupee edges lower as dollar firms on Fed hike wagers
item.description: The Indian rupee was modestly weaker on Wednesday, tracking a dip in regional currencies as the prospect of interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve in the near term lifted the dollar index to its highest level since late July.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee was modestly weaker on Wednesday, tracking a dip in regional currencies as the prospect of interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve in the near term lifted the dollar index to its highest level since late July. The rupee was down 0.1% at 95.6950 per dollar compared to its close at 95.59 in the previous session. Regional currencies were by weaker by 0.1% to 0.3%, with investors keeping a keen eye on oil prices and the scale of wagers on rate hikes by the Fed. Interest rate futures markets have baked in about 75 basis points worth of hikes over the next 12 months. The recent string of rate hikes and hawkish guidance from major central banks has been in focus for currency markets as the US-Israeli conflict with Iran drives oil prices higher and fans inflation worries. On the day, Brent crude oil slipped about 1% to $98.4 per barrel on hopes that diplomacy at the UN General Assembly could pave the way for a resolution to the Middle East war. US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he could "annihilate" Iran [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"if there is no deal"], but also suggested an agreement could come soon. Weakness in capital flows and stress on account of an elevated energy bill have translated to pressure on the rupee, partially absorbed by frequent central bank interventions that have kept the currency's losses in check. Traders reckon that rhythm is likely to persist in the near term, especially after the central bank's [USN:L4N45D0V1 TEXT:"bountiful haul"] of capital inflows under one-off policy measures to attract foreign currency boosted India's FX reserves to a record high. "If USD/INR sustains below 95.70, the probability of a move towards 95.00–95.20 will increase, while 96.00 continues to act as a strong ceiling backed by RBI intervention," said Amit Pabari, managing director at FX advisory firm CR Forex.

item.title: アジア途上国の26年成長予測引き上げ、インフレ予測は下げ＝ＡＤＢ
item.description:
[マニラ ２３日 ロイター] - アジア開発銀行（ＡＤＢ）は２３日、今年のアジア太平洋開発途上国の成長見通しを従来の４．９％から５．０％に小幅に上方修正した一方、インフレ見通しは下方修正した。堅調な投資、政府の景気刺激策、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の輸出がエネルギー価格高騰や地政学的緊張の影響を打ち消していると指摘した。
リスクは依然として下振れ方向に傾いているとし、エネルギー価格の高止まりとエルニーニョ現象の激化が成長を圧迫し、インフレ圧力を強める恐れがあると警告した。
• ２０２７年の成長率見通しは５．１％に据え置いた。
• ２６年のインフレ見通しは７月時点の４．３％から４．２％に引き下げた。一方、２７年については、エルニーニョ現象の影響がより強まるとの予想を踏まえ、３．４％から３．５％に上方修正した。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[マニラ ２３日 ロイター] - アジア開発銀行（ＡＤＢ）は２３日、今年のアジア太平洋開発途上国の成長見通しを従来の４．９％から５．０％に小幅に上方修正した一方、インフレ見通しは下方修正した。堅調な投資、政府の景気刺激策、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の輸出がエネルギー価格高騰や地政学的緊張の影響を打ち消していると指摘した。

リスクは依然として下振れ方向に傾いているとし、エネルギー価格の高止まりとエルニーニョ現象の激化が成長を圧迫し、インフレ圧力を強める恐れがあると警告した。

• ２０２７年の成長率見通しは５．１％に据え置いた。

• ２６年のインフレ見通しは７月時点の４．３％から４．２％に引き下げた。一方、２７年については、エルニーニョ現象の影響がより強まるとの予想を踏まえ、３．４％から３．５％に上方修正した。

• 中国の需要鈍化や、燃料価格上昇から消費者を守る南アジアの政府の取り組みが、今年のインフレ抑制に寄与する見込みだとした。

• コーカサス・中央アジア・西アジア地域や太平洋地域では成長見通しを引き下げたものの、東南アジアと南アジアの成長見通しの改善、政府の景気刺激策、ＡＩ関連の輸出需要が地域全体の成長見通し上方修正を支えたと説明した。

• 中東紛争の長期化やロシアによるウクライナ侵攻を背景としたエネルギー価格の高止まりと変動が、引き続き見通しの重しとなっていると指摘した。

• ＡＤＢは域内の中央銀行が今年、インフレリスクと成長下支えのバランスを取る中で政策金利をおおむね据え置いてきたとしつつ、今後の政策の道筋は各国の国内情勢次第で分かれる見通しだとした。

• アジア太平洋開発途上国は５つのサブ地域にまたがるＡＤＢ加盟４３カ国で構成される。

item.title: 中国の駐米大使、首脳会談前に「レッドライン」警告 台湾や人権巡り
item.description: [北京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国の謝鋒駐米大使は２３日、今週ワシントンで開催される米中首脳会談を前に、台湾や人権などの問題で「レッドライン（越えてはならない一線）」があると警告した。

中国の習近平国家主席はトランプ米大統領との首脳会談のためワシントンを訪問する。両国は、貿易から台湾に至る幅広い問題を巡る対立で緊張する米中関係に、安定をもたらそうとしている。

謝氏は、中国共産党機関紙「人民日報」への寄稿で、意見の相違を管理する上では誠意が鍵になると指摘。米国は中国を封じ込めようと安全保障、経済不均衡、強制労働などの「口実をでっち上げる」ことをやめるべきだと述べた。

また、中国と米国が協力すれば双方に利益があり、対立すれば双方に不利益が及ぶと指摘した。

謝氏は「中国の主権、安全保障、発展の利益は侵害されてはならず、台湾問題、民主主義と人権、発展の道筋と制度、発展の権利という４つのレッドラインに挑むことは許されない」と述べた。

「中国は平和的発展を追求することにコミットしており、米国もこの方向に進むことを期待する」とした。

米国は台湾にとって最も重要な武器供給国であり、国際的な後ろ盾でもある。中国は台湾への武器売却をやめるよう繰り返し要求してきた。

トランプ氏は今年５月に北京で習氏と首脳会談を行った後、約１４０億ドル相当の新たな武器供与パッケージを保留していると明かし、「非常に良い交渉材料」だと述べた。

台湾の安全保障担当高官は記者団に対し、中国は米国の武器供与の遅延を台湾の軍備増強を減速させる直接的な手段と見なしており、それによって中国が台湾、日本、フィリピンの周辺で圧力を強める余地が生まれると指摘した。

また、中国は米国製品の購入や中東情勢を巡る配慮などさまざまなインセンティブを用いて、地域における米国の軍事的関与を縮小すれば中国からより広範な協力が得られるとトランプ氏を説得する可能性があると述べた。

中国国務院台湾事務弁公室の朱鳳蓮報道官は、対立を「意図的に」エスカレートさせているのは台湾側だと非難。「独立を画策することが、台湾海峡の平和と安定を破壊し、現状を損なう元凶だ」と述べた。

２３日付の人民日報の別の論評は、米国の中国に対する「誤った」認識と、戦略的競争という考え方を捨てられないことが、両国関係の困難の根本原因だと指摘した。

「近年、中米関係がたどってきた曲折した道のりは、米国の中国に対する誤った認識と、『戦略的競争』という考え方を手放そうとしない姿勢が、繰り返される困難の根本原因であることを明確に示している」と論じた。

その上で、双方が「多大な代償」を払って得られた好ましいモメンタムを大切にし、正しい方向を維持し、干渉を排除すべきだとし、「特に米国側は政策の継続性と安定性を維持し、約束を履行し、２国間関係に確実性をもたらす必要がある」と述べた。

item.title: 日米首脳会談、中国について「率直な意見交換」と高市首相
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[２３日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は２２日（日本時間２３日）、国連総会出席のため訪問中の米ニューヨークでトランプ米大統領と会談した。高市氏はソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」で、中国や北朝鮮に関する課題について、「率直な意見交換を行った」と明かした。人工知能（ＡＩ）や半導体、重要鉱物など経済安全保障の分野で「技術競争に勝ち、強靭性を高めるための協力を確認」したとも発信した。

高市氏は投稿の中で、経済安全保障についての協力を日米間で「更に強化していくこととした」と説明。米国による追加関税をめぐる対米投資の合意についても、「着実な実施の重要性を改めて確認し、双方で協力を進めていくことで一致した」という。

また、中国や北朝鮮も議題に上ったとし、特に北朝鮮による拉致問題について「即時解決の重要性を改めて強調し、トランプ大統領から、全面的な支持を得ることができた」と説明した。一方、中国についての具体的な議論には言及しなかった。米国が赤根智子所長らを制裁対象にした国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）に関する考えについても、「率直なやり取りを行った」と付け加えた。

米側では、ホワイトハウスがＸに会談の写真を掲載。「トランプ大統領と日本の高市早苗首相が国連総会で、日米両国の強固な同盟関係を一段と深めている」と書き込んだ。

トランプ氏は２４日に中国の習近平国家主席と会談する予定で、日本はその前に日米首脳会談を開き、米国との間で認識をすり合わせることを模索していた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：久保信博）

item.title: 米ＡＩ責任者にベセント氏か、トランプ氏が近く任命
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が近く任命すると表明した米政府の新たな人工知能（ＡＩ）担当責任者にベセント財務長官が就任する可能性があると、事情に詳しい関係者が２２日明らかにした。

別の関係者は、決定はまだ下されていないと述べた。財務省はコメントしていない。

トランプ氏は１９日、新たなＡＩ担当責任者を任命し、「ＡＩフォース」を創設する計画だと交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿していた。ただ、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

ベセント氏は２０日、ワシントンで今週開かれるトランプ氏と中国の習近平国家主席の首脳会談を前に、ニューヨークで中国の何立峰副首相と協議した。ＡＩに関する議論が焦点の一つとなり、ベセント氏は会談後、ＡＩの安全性に関する新たな通知メカニズムを提案したと明らかにした。

item.title: Brandon Williamson fires 6 scoreless innings as Reds blank Braves
item.description: Brandon Williamson fired six scoreless innings and the Cincinnati Reds supported him with three solo homers to defeat the host Atlanta Braves 4-0 on Tuesday in the opener of their three-game series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brandon Williamson fired six scoreless innings and the Cincinnati Reds supported him with three solo homers to defeat the host Atlanta Braves 4-0 on Tuesday in the opener of their three-game series. Cincinnati (73-84) ended a two-game losing streak and evened the season series with Atlanta (92-65) at 2-2. Williamson (5-4) worked six scoreless innings, allowing three hits and two strikeouts. It was his longest stint since going 6 2/3 scoreless against Miami on April 6. Williamson benefited from two double plays and did not allow a runner to reach scoring position. Elly De La Cruz (29), Dane Myers (8) and Eugenio Suarez (25) each hit a home run for the Reds. It was Suarez's 350th career homer, making him the 10th active player to reach that mark. Cincinnati got a scoreless seventh inning of relief from Brock Burke, who stranded runners at second and third. Tejay Antone loaded the bases in the eighth before retiring slugger Matt Olson on a fly ball. Closer Emilio Pagan allowed a double but did not allow a run in the ninth. Atlanta starter JR Ritchie (1-4) pitched five innings and allowed one run on four hits and three walks. The rookie struck out a career-high eight batters. The Reds broke through for a run in the third inning on a solo homer from De La Cruz. His homer had just enough steam to travel 368 feet and clear the right field wall. Cincinnati added another run in the sixth on a solo homer by Myers, a 410-foot shot to straightaway center off reliever Owen Murphy. The Reds added another run in the seventh. With Matt McLain on third and one out, De La Cruz lined an RBI single off shortstop Ha-Seong Kim's glove. Suarez led off the eighth inning with a 415-foot homer off Murphy into the seats in left-center field. The Braves lost right fielder Ronald Acuna Jr. in the third inning. Acuna fouled a pitch off his left shin, which was unprotected by padding, and limped to the dugout. X-rays were negative, and Acuna was listed as day-to-day. --Field Level Media

item.title: South Korea says Trump welcomes progress in US strategic investment projects
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and US President Donald Trump welcomed "significant progress" in discussions on strategic investment projects during a 30-minute meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Seoul's presidential office said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim, Heejin Kim
item.content:encoded: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and US President Donald Trump welcomed "significant progress" in discussions on strategic investment projects during a 30-minute meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Seoul's presidential office said on Wednesday. The meeting came after South Korea's Industry Ministry [USN:L1N45E006 TEXT:"briefed lawmakers"] on Tuesday on implementation plans under the countries' $350 billion investment package, including a Texas gas-fired power project identified as a potential first investment, as well as possible investments in nuclear energy and an Alaskan LNG project. "The two leaders welcomed the significant progress made in discussions on strategic investment projects between the two countries," National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac told a briefing. Based on the Joint Fact Sheet issued after their summit last November, Lee and Trump also agreed to deepen cooperation and continue discussions on issues including nuclear fuel enrichment and reprocessing, nuclear-powered submarines, shipbuilding and the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the US to South Korea, Wi said. Trump also reaffirmed his willingness to engage in dialogue with North Korea, Wi said, with the two leaders agreeing to remain in close communication in pursuit of a peace process. Lee also said the US-China summit scheduled for Thursday would be important for regional developments, including South Korea-China relations, according to Wi. The White House did not immediately comment on the Trump-Lee meeting. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday called for the swift execution of South Korean investment commitments during a [USN:L1N45A115 TEXT:"meeting"] with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, the State Department said. In a post on X, Lee said he had an in-depth discussion with Trump on the progress made on investment projects and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the alliance. DISCUSSED NORTH KOREA, GOLF Earlier on Wednesday, Lee told the UN General Assembly that Seoul would support efforts to revive dialogue with North Korea and work toward a durable peace framework while seeking broader international backing for those efforts. A senior presidential official separately told South Korean media outlets that Lee had told Trump he hoped the US president would help advance engagement with North Korea, to which Trump replied that he would do so. The official said Trump also remarked that he maintained a good relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, though there was no indication of any specific contact currently taking place, the media reports said. The official said Lee and Trump also spent considerable time discussing OPCON transfer, with Trump gaining a better understanding of Seoul's position. The US side stressed the need to meet the required conditions and complete the process as soon as possible. The South Korean side outlined plans to increase defence spending, while expressing a desire to accelerate talks on developing nuclear-powered submarines, the official said. The official was also quoted as saying that progress in talks on investments in US projects helped pave the way for the summit, which had not initially been expected to take place. The two leaders had been briefed on the negotiations and welcomed the progress, but discussions were still under way on the details of the package and how it would be announced, the official said. "The bigger framework is almost complete," the official was quoted as saying. Lee later said on X that Trump had reminded him of their plan to play golf together, first [USN:L4N42Q022 TEXT:"discussed"] in France in June, and that he hoped they could continue their discussions at the G20 summit in Miami later this year.

item.title: Asia stocks ride tech wave higher, oil slips again
item.description: Asian shares were aiming for a sixth session of gains on Wednesday as consumer hunger for AI apps continued to buoy tech stocks, while oil prices fell further on reports of increased supply out of the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Cole
item.content:encoded: Asian shares were aiming for a sixth session of gains on Wednesday as consumer hunger for AI apps continued to buoy tech stocks, while oil prices fell further on reports of increased supply out of the Middle East. Sources told Reuters [USN:L1N45E09V TEXT:"Saudi Arabia"] had restarted operations at its East-West Pipeline and may have already resumed exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu. [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"US President Donald Trump"] also claimed talks with Iran in New York had made progress, but then threatened to "annihilate" the country if a deal was not done. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addresses the UN General Assembly later on Wednesday and markets are alive to reports he might hold talks with Trump. Brent futures slipped 0.9% to $98.37 a barrel, while US crude dropped 1.3% to $89.32 a barrel. Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Washington later in the day amid speculation a trade truce between the two countries will be extended, and there could be cooperation over AI. Renewed buzz over AI helped South Korean stocks (.KS11) gain 0.5%, with Samsung (005930.KS) up over 2%, while Taiwan (.TWII) firmed 0.7% to near all-time peaks. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) added 0.3%, having now risen for six straight days. Chinese blue chips (.CSI300) eased 0.5%. Japanese markets were closed for a holiday, but Nikkei futures were trading at 66,735 , almost 1,700 points above where the cash Nikkei (.N225) closed on Friday. "We expect a strong reopening in Japan tomorrow, with another move lower in crude, calm conditions in rates and Treasuries, and the Nasdaq cash and futures markets printing all-time highs," said Chris Weston, head of research at broker Pepperstone. "Memory stocks have taken the leadership baton, backed by another strong session for semis, which have recorded a sixth consecutive day of gains." CONSUMERS FALL FOR AI AGENTS The data hardware sector has been buoyed by strong consumer take up of Meta's (META.O) [USN:L6N45E0Y4 TEXT:"Muse agent"], which has topped US app download charts in the past two weeks. Analysts are now keen to see how a similar product from Google Labs known as CC will fare with consumers. Also of note was demand for [USN:L4N45F05V TEXT:"SoftBank's"] (9984.T) $10 billion-plus debt deal which has reportedly drawn more than $20 billion in indications of interest. That would make it one of the largest junk bond deals ever. On Wall Street, S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq futures were both a fraction firmer. In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures , DAX futures and FTSE futures were all up almost 0.4%. The dip in oil helped Treasury futures nudge higher, keeping 10-year yields below the 5.0% pain barrier. However, two-year yields had again hit their highest since mid-2024 at 4.7879% as investors priced in the risk of more tightening from the Federal Reserve. Richmond Fed President [USN:S0N4490DQ TEXT:"Tom Barkin"] and Boston Fed President [USN:S0N4490DQ TEXT:"Susan Collins"] on Tuesday both voiced support for last week's rise in interest rates given concerns about inflation. Futures markets imply a 54% chance the Fed will hike again in October and have 33 basis points of tightening priced in by year end. The prospect of higher rates helped the dollar eke out multi-week highs on the euro, sterling and Canadian dollar, improving its technical background. The euro was left pinned at $1.1430 and near a two-month low. Analysts noted a call from Trump to ban [USN:L6N45E0WU TEXT:"U.S. diesel exports"], was potentially bad news for European inflation since the zone relied heavily on U.S. shipments of the fuel. Europe already faces a shortage of natural gas that could push energy prices higher into the winter. The dollar was a shade firmer on the yen at 157.60 , with speculators wary of drawing more Japanese intervention on any push past 160.00. In commodity markets, gold eased 0.3% to $4,341 an ounce , while copper neared record highs having climbed 18% so far this year.

FAST

PERTH, Sept 23 : Oil prices drifted lower on Wednesday as Saudi Arabia began restoring crude supply on a critical pipeline to the Red Sea and on hopes for a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran war through talks at the UN in New York. Brent crude futures fell 7 cents, or 0.07 per cent, to $99.18 a barrel as of 0119 GMT while West Texas Intermediate futures fell 35 cents, or 0.39 per cent, to $90.17 per barrel. While US President Donald Trump warned on Tuesday that he could "annihilate" Iran, he also said his envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had held productive talks with mediators of Iran to end the war. "I think there's a lot of momentum for them to make a deal," Trump said.

Optimism around improved supply and a push to end the nearly seven-month conflict drove benchmark Brent down to close below $100 a barrel on Tuesday for the first time since September 8. “The market is currently feeling more constructive about the global oil supply picture than it was a few weeks ago,” said Tim Waterer, chief analyst at KCM Trade. “The meeting of US and Iranian delegations in New York has given traders a glimmer of hope ... Despite the continued tough rhetoric, including threats of ‘annihilation,’ the market is choosing to price in the possibility of talks.” On Tuesday, Saudi Arabia restarted operations on its East-West Pipeline to the Red Sea, three sources briefed on the matter said, with signs of an increase in Middle Eastern oil flows. Drone attacks, which Saudi Arabia has blamed on Iraqi militia, forced the kingdom to shut the pipeline on September 11, halting crude loadings at the kingdom's Yanbu port. Since the US-Israeli war on Iran disrupted oil flows from Saudi Arabia and its Gulf neighbours through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has been using the pipeline to reroute around 4 million barrels per day — around 4 per cent of global supply — to Yanbu. Iraq, too, is increasing oil exports, its oil minister, Basim Mohammed, said on Tuesday. The country is exporting more than 3 million bpd, he said, and expects to boost exports via Turkey to more than 600,000 bpd. Provisional data from shiptracking firms Vortexa and Kpler pegged Iraqi crude exports in August at 2.3 million and 2.17 million bpd, respectively, up from July's level but below February's pre-war level of 3.7 million and 3.362 million bpd. Adding to downward pressure on oil prices, industry data showed US crude inventories rose by 1.8 million barrels in the week to September 18, while analysts polled by Reuters had expected a decline. Official weekly inventory figures from the US Energy Information Administration are due at 10:30 a.m. ET (1430 GMT).

Source: Reuters

item.title: サッカー＝レアル、バルベルデが左足首の靱帯断裂
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部、レアル・マドリードは２２日、ウルグアイ代表ＭＦフェデリコ・バルベルデが左足首を捻挫したと発表。負傷の程度は靱帯の完全断裂を意味するグレード３であることを明らかにした。

バルベルデは２０日の国内リーグ、アトレチコ・マドリード戦で李康仁から激しいタックルを受けて負傷。このプレーに対してカードは出されず、レアルのジョゼ・モウリーニョ監督はＰＫが与えられなかったことで主審の判断を批判していた。

バルベルデは最後までプレーしたものの、その後、靱帯損傷で最も重篤な状態にあることが判明。スペインメディアによれば、２─３週間の離脱が見込まれており、ウルグアイ代表の試合は欠場見込みとなっている。

item.title: Oil falls on better supply outlook, hopes for US-Iran talks
item.description: Oil prices extended declines on Wednesday as investors eyed improved Gulf supply after Saudi Arabia restarted operations at a critical pipeline.
item.dc:creator: Helen Clark, Siyi Liu
item.content:encoded: Oil prices extended declines on Wednesday as investors eyed improved Gulf supply after Saudi Arabia restarted operations at a critical pipeline. Hopes for a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran war also weighed on prices. Brent crude futures fell 78 cents, or 0.79%, to $98.47 a barrel as of 0651 GMT while West Texas Intermediate futures fell $1.21, or 1.34%, to $89.31 per barrel. Both contracts have declined for six consecutive sessions to around two-week lows. While US President Donald Trump warned on Tuesday that he could "annihilate" Iran, he also said his envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had held [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"productive talks"] with mediators of Iran to end the war. "I think there's a lot of momentum for them to make a deal," Trump said. Optimism around improved supply and a push to end the nearly seven-month conflict drove benchmark Brent down to close below $100 a barrel on Tuesday for the first time since September 8. “The market is currently feeling more constructive about the global oil supply picture than it was a few weeks ago,” said Tim Waterer, chief analyst at KCM Trade. “The meeting of US and Iranian delegations in New York has given traders a glimmer of hope ... Despite the continued tough rhetoric, including threats of ‘annihilation,’ the market is choosing to price in the possibility of talks.” On Tuesday, Saudi Arabia [USN:L1N45E09V TEXT:"restarted operations"] on its East-West Pipeline to the Red Sea, three sources briefed on the matter said, with signs of an increase in Middle Eastern oil flows. Drone attacks, which Saudi Arabia has blamed on Iraqi militia, forced the kingdom to shut the pipeline on September 11, halting crude loadings at the kingdom's Yanbu port. Since the US-Israeli war on Iran disrupted oil flows from Saudi Arabia and its Gulf neighbours through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has been using the pipeline to reroute around 4 million barrels per day — around 4% of global supply — to Yanbu. Saudi on Tuesday also [USN:L4N45E0RC TEXT:"offered more barrels"] to Asian refiners for lifting from locations outside of the Strait of Hormuz. Iraq, too, is increasing oil exports, its oil minister, Basim Mohammed, said on Tuesday. The country is exporting more than 3 million bpd, he said, and expects to [USN:L1N45E0YT TEXT:"boost exports via Turkey"] to more than 600,000 bpd. Provisional data from shiptracking firms Vortexa and Kpler pegged Iraqi crude exports [USN:L1N44U0HX TEXT:"in August"] at 2.3 million and 2.17 million bpd, respectively, up from July's level but below February's pre-war level of 3.7 million and 3.362 million bpd. Adding to downward pressure on oil prices, industry data showed [USN:L6N45F00K TEXT:"US crude inventories rose"] by 1.8 million barrels in the week to September 18. Analysts [USN:L1N45F007 TEXT:"polled by Reuters"] had expected a decline. Official weekly inventory figures from the US Energy Information Administration are due at 10:30 a.m. ET (1430 GMT). Trump said on Tuesday that he backed the idea of a diesel export ban as a way to lower prices that have hit record highs due to a global supply shortage. But analysts and market watchers warn that such a measure would [USN:L6N45E11V TEXT:"do little to ease"] high energy prices, and could worsen supply and economic disruptions around the globe.

item.title: Dollar at 2-month highs as markets weigh rate hikes, Iran diplomacy
item.description: The dollar rose to its strongest level in two months on Wednesday on prospects of interest rate hikes in the near term, although easing oil prices could alter the global inflation and monetary policy outlook.
item.dc:creator: Ankur Banerjee
item.content:encoded: The dollar rose to its strongest level in two months on Wednesday on prospects of interest rate hikes in the near term, although easing oil prices could alter the global inflation and monetary policy outlook. The euro eased to its weakest level since late July and was last at $1.14282. Sterling bought $1.3316. The dollar index , which measures the US currency against six rivals, was 0.16% higher at 100.71. The recent barrage of rate hikes and hawkish rhetoric from major central banks has taken centre stage in currency markets as the US-Israeli conflict with Iran drives oil prices higher and fans inflation worries. Investors are now anticipating further tightening from central banks, with Federal Reserve officials flagging the possibility of more hikes if inflation does not ease. "The dollar's support from rates looks durable, but futures already price more tightening than the Fed's own projections, so the dollar now needs the data to confirm it," said Kieran Williams, head of Asia FX at Intouch Capital Markets. "The oil support is weaker, with Brent at a two-week low on (Strait of)Hormuz reopening reports," he said, referring to Iran raising the prospect of [USN:L1N45E0GD TEXT:"reopening"] the critical waterway. Oil markets remain in the spotlight with Brent crude futures slipping to $98.46 per barrel on hopes that diplomacy at the UN General Assembly could pave the way for a resolution to the seven-month-long Middle East war. [O/R] Brent has risen 37% since the conflict erupted at the end of February, but has declined for six straight sessions amid easing supply concerns and rising optimism of a breakthrough. US President Donald Trump warned that he could annihilate Iran if there is no deal to end the war, but also suggested an agreement could come soon amid the diplomatic efforts at the UN. "The good news is that oil prices have moderated somewhat from the highs but the path forward remains unclear given the lack of clarity around a possible resolution of the conflict," said Michael Wan, a currency analyst at MUFG. Investors are also waiting for a high-stakes meeting between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping as the two leaders seek stability in a relationship under pressure over wide-ranging [USN:L1N45D0TZ TEXT:"issues"]. The Japanese yen was at 157.58 per US dollar as traders remain wary of the threat of intervention after markets judged the Bank of Japan's rate hike to a 31-year high last week as insufficiently hawkish. Two dissenting votes and the absence of a clear hawkish signal were enough to fuel doubts over how quickly the BOJ will tighten policy, particularly after the Fed raised rates last week and flagged further hikes ahead. Japanese markets are closed for a holiday and the low liquidity period is seen by analysts as an optimal time for authorities to intervene if needed. "The BOJ hike didn't narrow the (yield) gap because the Fed hiked by the same amount two days earlier, so the lean is still higher," said Intouch's Williams. "160 (per US dollar) remains the risk, but officials have reportedly moved away from telegraphing intervention and from any fixed level, so the cap could come earlier and in other forms."

item.title: GM CEO Mary Barra to attend Trump's state dinner for Xi, sources say
item.description: General Motors CEO Mary Barra is expected to attend US President Donald Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Chinese President Xi Jinping, two sources familiar with the matter said, as US automakers warn against allowing Chinese manufacturers into the market, while Trump signals he may be open to it.
item.dc:creator: Nora Eckert, Kalea Hall, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: General Motors (GM.N) CEO Mary Barra is expected to attend US President Donald Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Chinese President Xi Jinping, two sources familiar with the matter said, as US automakers warn against allowing Chinese manufacturers into the market, while Trump signals he may be open to it. Barra will not be joined by Stellantis (STLAM.MI) CEO Antonio Filosa, who is out of the country, two sources said. Ford (F.N) declined to comment on if CEO Jim Farley would attend the dinner. The automaker recently came under fire from US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy for its business partnerships with Chinese companies. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The US government has set up numerous trade barriers and policies to keep Chinese automakers out. Still, the president, as recently as this month, said he is willing to let these global auto giants into the country if they employ US workers at their plants. "If China wanted to come in and open a plant to build their cars here, I'd be okay with that," Trump said in an interview on Fox News. Major automakers, suppliers and dealers responded by urging Trump to keep Chinese carmakers out of the market. Barra will be joining a number of tech and industry leaders at the dinner, including executives from Meta (META.O) , Apple (AAPL.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) .

DETROIT, Sept 22 : General Motors CEO Mary Barra is expected to attend US President Donald Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Chinese President Xi Jinping, two sources familiar with the matter said, as US automakers warn against allowing Chinese manufacturers into the market, while Trump signals he may be open to it. Barra will not be joined by Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa, who is out of the country, two sources said. Ford declined to comment if CEO Jim Farley would attend the dinner. The automaker recently came under fire from US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy for its business partnerships with Chinese companies.  The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Bryson Stott's 8th-inning hit lifts Phillies past Brewers
item.description: Bryson Stott delivered the tiebreaking hit in the eighth inning to guide the Philadelphia Phillies to a 6-4 victory over the visiting Milwaukee Brewers on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Bryson Stott delivered the tiebreaking hit in the eighth inning to guide the Philadelphia Phillies to a 6-4 victory over the visiting Milwaukee Brewers on Tuesday. Brandon Marsh homered and knocked in three runs for Philadelphia (87-70), which lowered its magic number to two to clinch a postseason berth. Zack Wheeler ended up with a no-decision after striking out 11 while giving up three runs and five hits in 5 2/3 innings. Wheeler struck out the first seven batters he faced, setting a Phillies record for consecutive strikeouts to begin a game. His first-inning strikeout of Brice Turang was the 2,000th of his career. Milwaukee (98-59) saw its lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers for the top record in the majors shrink to one as they lost for just the third time in its last 13 games. William Contreras knocked in three runs for the Brewers. Despite the loss, the Brewers clinched a first-round bye and home-field advantage in the National League after the Atlanta Braves (92-65) lost to the Cincinnati Reds. Working his fifth inning of relief for Milwaukee, Colton Gordon (0-1) notched the first two outs of the eighth inning before allowing singles to Luis Arraez and Alec Bohm. Stott then lined a slider into center field to score Arraez. Center fielder Garrett Mitchell's throw toward third hit Bohm and caromed away, allowing Bohm to score for a 5-3 lead. Marsh followed with an RBI double to make it 6-3. The Brewers got a run against Jhoan Duran in the ninth, but the Phillies' closer slammed the door for his 33rd save. Philadelphia took an early lead on Marsh's two-run homer off Dustin May in the second inning. The hosts tacked on another run against Kyle Harrison in the third as Bohm delivered a two-out RBI double. Meanwhile, Wheeler did not allow a hit until Garrett Mitchell reached on an infield single to open the fourth. Brice Turang singled two batters later and Contreras supplied a sacrifice fly to make it 3-1. After an uneventful fifth inning, Milwaukee tied it against Wheeler in the sixth. David Hamilton singled to open the frame and Jackson Chourio walked with one out. A double steal put two runners in scoring position for Contreras, whose base hit drew the visitors even at 3-3. Tim Mayza got Philadelphia out of the sixth before Alex McFarlane retired all five batters he faced. Jose Alvarado (5-3) recorded the final out of the eighth, setting the stage for the late heroics. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝エムバペ、インフルエンザ様症状で代表の練習欠席
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス代表主将キリアン・エムバペが２２日、インフルエンザに似た症状が出たことにより代表練習を欠席した。フランス・サッカー連盟（ＦＦＦ）が明らかにした。直近に控える欧州ネーションズリーグでの出場に不透明感が出ている。

レアル・マドリード（スペイン）に所属するエムバペは代表のトレーニング拠点に残り、他の選手は練習に参加した。

この日はジネディーヌ・ジダン新監督の下で２回目の練習となった。フランスは２５日に敵地でトルコと対戦するが、ジダン監督にとっては代表指揮官としての初陣となる。

フランスは今回の代表活動期間中、ベルギーとホーム、アウェーで対戦するほか、イタリアもホームに迎える予定。

item.title: サッカー＝アルテタ監督、アーセナルとの新契約で合意─報道
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、昨季王者のアーセナルがミケル・アルテタ監督（４４）と条件面を改善した新契約に合意した。同監督の契約は今季で満了の予定だった。英ＢＢＣが２２日に報じた。

アルテタ監督は２０１９年にアーセナルの指揮官に就任すると、チームの改革に着手。３年連続でリーグ２位フィニッシュとなった後、昨季ついに２２年ぶりの優勝を手にした。ジョシュ・クロンキ共同会長は今年５月、アルテタ監督の残留がクラブの最優先事項と話していた。

今季のアーセナルは連覇に向けて好調なスタートを切っており、リーグ開幕から４連勝。１９日のブライトン戦で０─３と敗れたが、５試合を終えて２位につけている。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキースのジャッジ、ＷＣシリーズ欠場濃厚
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ヤンキースの主将アーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）が、宿敵レッドソックスとのア・リーグのワイルドカード（ＷＣ）シリーズを欠場する可能性が高いことが分かった。

アーロン・ブーン監督は２２日、ジャッジについて「出場しないことを前提に考えている」と明らかにした。

ヤンキースは１９日、右ふくらはぎを痛めたジャッジを１０日間の負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）に登録。ブーン監督はけがの程度を「中程度」と説明しており、ジャッジは２１日の休養日に患部へ乏血小板血漿（ＰＰＰ）注射を受けたという。

ジャッジは肋骨のけがで今季３カ月以上離脱し、今月８日に復帰。復帰後は２３打数４安打の打率１割７分４厘、１本塁打、３打点、１３三振だった。今季は６６試合に出場し、打率２割４分１厘、１８本塁打、４１打点。

オールスター選出８回で、リーグ最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に３度輝いている。２０１６年のメジャーデビューからヤンキース一筋で、通算１２１１試合出場、打率２割９分１厘、３８６本塁打、８７１打点を記録している。

２２日時点では、ヤンキースが第４シード、レッドソックスが第５シードとして、２９日からヤンキースの本拠地で３試合制のＷＣシリーズを戦う組み合わせとなっている。

item.title: マクロン氏、ガザ和平巡りトランプ氏批判 「恥ずべき光景」
item.description:
John Irish
[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
John Irish

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、パレスチナ自治区ガザで和平を実現したとするトランプ米大統領の主張を退け、同地区では人道回廊が一つも再開されていないと述べた。

来年５月に退任するマクロン氏は、国連総会で最後の一般討論演説に臨んだ。その中で、世界は誰もが恥ずべき光景を目の当たりにしていると述べ、トランプ氏がガザ和平計画を外交上の勝利として誇示していることを非難した。

「１年前、まさにこの議場で十数カ国がパレスチナを国家承認した。『承認は単なる紙切れだ、現実を見よ』という一部の冷笑的な声も耳にする」と拳で演壇をたたきながら述べた。

「しかし、ガザを前に行動しないままでいるなら、われわれにどんな信頼性があるというのか。和平と称するものを誇る者もいる。だが、その和平は１秒たりとも人道支援へのアクセスを再開させていない。われわれ全てが恥じるべきこの光景を、ただ傍観していてよいのか」と問いかけた。

マクロン氏の批判に対し、ホワイトハウスのケリー報道官は「トランプ大統領はイスラエルとイスラム組織ハマスの戦争を終結させ、生存していた人質全員を解放し、死亡した人々の遺体を遺族の元に返し、現在はガザ和平のための２０項目計画の実施を主導している」と反論。「他者が口先だけで論じている間に、大統領はこの複雑な問題に真正面から取り組んだ。この地域の平和と安定のために、これほど尽くした人物は他にいない」と述べた。

item.description: SEOUL, Sept 23 : South Korea aims to reduce its reliance on crude oil from the Middle East to 50 per cent by 2035, as Asia's fourth-biggest economy seeks to diversify energy supplies following the disruption caused by the Iran war, the Industry Ministry said on Wednesday. In its 10-year natural resources secu

item.content:encoded:

South Korea plans to cut its reliance on Middle crude oil imports to 50% by 2035

SEOUL, Sept 23 : South Korea aims to reduce its reliance on crude oil from the Middle East to 50 per cent by 2035, as Asia's fourth-biggest economy seeks to diversify energy supplies following the disruption caused by the Iran war, the Industry Ministry said on Wednesday. In its 10-year natural resources security plan, the ministry said the country needed a "fundamental shift" in its supply chains, citing lessons from the Iran war, which has choked off global energy flows. South Korea relies heavily on oil imports and sourced 70 per cent of its supplies from the Middle East in 2025, most of it delivered through the Strait of Hormuz, according to the ministry. Under the updated strategy, the country adjusted its stockpiling plan for crude oil, targeting an expansion of around 20 million barrels by 2030.

South Korea also aims to secure additional supplies of condensate, an ultra-light oil mainly used to produce naphtha, the ministry said. The country has struggled with a shortage of naphtha, the key feedstock for petrochemicals, since the Middle East conflict. South Korea relies on imports to satisfy about 45 per cent of its naphtha demand, with 77 per cent of those supplies typically sourced from the Middle East, according to the ministry. For natural gas, the government aims to cap its import dependence on the Middle East to below 30 per cent by 2035, after lowering it to 20 per cent in 2025. The roadmap will also expand South Korea's list of critical minerals to 51 from 38, adding 10 rare earths and germanium, a critically important component for the production of semiconductors, as part of efforts to strengthen supply chains.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Taiwan, human rights are 'red lines' for China, ambassador says ahead of Trump, Xi meeting
item.description: Taiwan and human rights are "red lines" for China that cannot be crossed, the country's ambassador to the US warned on Wednesday, striking a firm tone ahead of this week's leadership summit in Washington.
item.dc:creator: Liz Lee, Yimou Lee
item.content:encoded: Taiwan and human rights are "red lines" for China that cannot be crossed, the country's ambassador to the US warned on Wednesday, striking a firm tone ahead of this week's leadership summit in Washington. Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit Washington for a summit with President Donald Trump, as both sides look to bring stability to ties overshadowed by arguments over everything from [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"trade"] to [USN:L1N45E095 TEXT:"Taiwan"]. Writing in the ruling Communist Party's official People's Daily on the day Xi is due to leave, Ambassador Xie Feng said managing differences hinges on good faith, and the US should stop "fabricating pretexts" such as national security, economic imbalances and forced labour to try to and constrain China. When China and the US cooperate, both benefit, but when they confront each other, both suffer, he added. "China's sovereignty, security, and development interests cannot be violated, and four red lines — the Taiwan question, democracy and human rights, development paths and systems, and development rights — cannot be challenged," Xie said. "China is committed to pursuing peaceful development and hopes the US will move toward this as well." China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, despite the objections of the government in Taipei. TAIWAN TENSIONS The US is Taiwan's most important arms supplier and international backer, and China has repeatedly demanded weapons sales to Taiwan end. After a May summit in Beijing with Xi, Trump said he was holding a [USN:L1N41S025 TEXT:"new arms package"], worth around $14 billion, in abeyance and described it as a "very good negotiating chip". A senior Taiwan security official told reporters that Beijing views any delay in US arms transfers as a direct way to slow Taiwan's military build up, giving China more room to expand pressure around Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines. China could use a package of inducements, including purchases of US goods or gestures on Middle East tensions, to convince Trump that reduced US military commitments in the region could buy broader cooperation from Beijing, the official said, speaking on condition of anonymity. China's military has significantly increased the number of naval, coast guard and research ships around Taiwan, in the South and East China Seas, and collecting data on things like undersea cables that could be useful for war, the official said. China's defence ministry did not respond to requests for comment. China's foreign ministry reiterated its "resolute opposition" to US arms sales, saying the Taiwan issue was its "core of core interests" and the political foundation of Sino-US ties. China has never renounced the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control, though says it would prefer "peaceful reunification". In Beijing, a spokesperson for Taiwan Affairs Office said it was Taiwan that was "deliberately" escalating confrontation. "Scheming for independence is the primary culprit in destroying peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait and undermining the status quo," spokesperson Zhu Fenglian said. 'ERRONEOUS' US PERCEPTIONS A separate commentary on Wednesday in the People's Daily said Washington's "erroneous" perceptions of China and its inability to let go of the notion of strategic competition are the basic causes of their difficult relationship. "In recent years, the tortuous path China-US relations have travelled clearly shows the US's erroneous perceptions of China and its unwillingness to let go of the notion of 'strategic competition' are the fundamental cause of recurring difficulties," said the commentary, without offering details. Both sides should cherish the favourable momentum that has come at "great cost, maintain the right direction, and eliminate interference", said the article, published under the pen name "Zhong Sheng", meaning "Voice of China" and used to give views on foreign policy. "The US side, in particular, needs to maintain continuity and stability in its policies, honour its commitments, and inject certainty into bilateral relations," it added.

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ラプターズ、カワイ・レナードと契約延長─報道
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のラプターズが、オールスター選出７回のカワイ・レナード（３５）と２年総額１億１５００万ドル（約１８１億円）の契約延長に合意した。米ＥＳＰＮが２２日に報じた。

代理人の話によると、２０２８─２９シーズンは選手オプション。レナードは今月１４日にクリッパーズからの移籍を完了させていた。レナードは最大契約延長額より１１００万ドル少ない金額を受け入れ、トレードキッカー（トレード時にボーナスが保証される契約条項）７５０万ドルも放棄した。

当初、レナードのラプターズ復帰は６月３０日に合意されていたが、レナードとクリッパーズによるサラリーキャップ（年俸総額制限）規定回避を巡るＮＢＡの調査を受けて、長く保留となっていた。

ＮＢＡは今月２日、クリッパーズがレナードを巡ってサラリーキャップ規定を回避したとして、球団に３０００万ドルの罰金を科し、２９年から３３年までのドラフト１巡目指名権を剥奪。レナードにも７０万ドルの支払いを命じた。

item.title: ロシアが新たな大規模攻撃を計画、ゼレンスキー氏警告
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２２日、ロシアが新たな大規模攻撃を計画しているとの見方を示した。

国連総会に合わせて行ったバーナム英首相との会談について通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿し、新たな防空システムの確保に向けて同盟国と絶えず連携していると明らかにした。

その上で「ロシアがウクライナに対する新たな大規模攻撃を準備しているとの情報が現在入っている」とした。

「ウクライナ国民が日々、ミサイルやドローン（無人機）による攻撃の脅威にさらされる」中で、対ロシア制裁の緩和を議論する余地はあり得ないとも強調した。

item.title: トランプ氏、ディーゼル燃料禁輸を支持 記録的高水準の価格抑制へ
item.description:
Gram Slattery Ryan Patrick Jones Timothy Gardner
[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Ryan Patrick Jones　Timothy Gardner

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を支持すると表明した。１１月の中間選挙で接戦となっている一部の選挙区の共和党候補らが、記録的水準に達している燃料価格を抑制する手段としてこの措置を求めていた。

トランプ氏はウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領との会談を前に記者団に対し、「私はディーゼル燃料の輸出はやめようと言ってきた。側近たちに対してそう訴えてきた」と述べた。

同席したベセント財務長官は、こうした禁止措置が実現可能かどうか、また全面禁輸と部分禁輸のどちらが効果的かを政権が検討していると述べた。

トランプ氏がディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を支持したことで、同氏はエネルギー当局者らと対立する形となった。

当局者らは、この措置が沿岸部の燃料価格を押し上げ、欧州の同盟国向けの供給を逼迫させる可能性があると警告している。

ライト・エネルギー長官は先週、保守系メディア「デイリー・コーラー」のイベントで、禁止措置は米メキシコ湾岸でディーゼル燃料の供給過剰を招き、米製油業者に稼働率の引き下げを促し、ガソリン生産の急速な減少につながると指摘。「流通に障壁を設け始めれば、極めて速やかに生産が減少し、供給が細る。われわれに必要なのは供給の増加であって、減少ではない」と語った。

また、バーガム内務長官は、禁止措置が石油製品価格を押し下げる可能性は低く、エネルギー輸出国による報復措置を招きかねないと述べた。カリフォルニア州などはエネルギーの一部をこうした輸出国に依存している。

item.title: サッカー＝ボルシアＭＧ、ブレッシン氏が新監督に 板倉ら所属
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで、板倉滉らが所属するボルシアＭＧは２２日、アレクサンダー・ブレッシン氏を新監督に任命した。契約は２０２８年６月まで。

ボルシアＭＧは今季開幕からリーグ戦４連敗を喫し、最下位に低迷。１３日にオイゲン・ポランスキ前監督を解任し、ヤンモリッツ・リヒテ氏を暫定監督に据えたが、１９日のマインツ戦にも３─４で敗れた。

ブレッシン氏は２４年から２年間、ザンクトパウリを指揮。就任１年目は残留に導いたが、昨季は２部に降格した。ドイツでトップチームを率いたのはザンクトパウリが初めてだったが、以前にはラルフ・ラングニック氏の下でライプチヒの育成年代を８年間指導。オーステンデ、サンジロワーズ（ともにベルギー）、ジェノア（イタリア）でも監督を務めた。

ボルシアＭＧには板倉のほか、橋岡大樹、宇野禅斗、町野修斗が所属している。

item.title: Wife of US seismologist held in China says Trump will ask Xi to free him
item.description: Yufang Rong said she feared that Beijing planned to try her Chinese-born husband, Youlin Chen, on fabricated espionage charges even though his US-funded research was openly published, used publicly available data and was done in collaboration with Chinese scientists.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Landay
item.content:encoded: The wife of a US expert on North Korean nuclear tests who has been imprisoned in China since late 2024 said on Tuesday the White House has assured her that President Donald Trump will ask Chinese leader Xi Jinping to free her husband when the pair meet this week. Yufang Rong said she feared that Beijing planned to try her Chinese-born husband, Youlin Chen, on fabricated espionage charges even though his US-funded research was openly published, used publicly available data and was done in collaboration with Chinese scientists. Trump will welcome Xi on Wednesday for their second meeting since May as the leaders of the world's leading powers seek stability amid tensions ranging from [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"trade "]to [USN:L8N4550G3 TEXT:"Iran "]and [USN:L4N45D00S TEXT:"Taiwan"]. Rong said she was assured during a Tuesday meeting at the White House with officials from the State Department and National Security Council that Trump would ask Xi to free her husband. Chen, 54, is one of two Americans held by Beijing that the US has designated as "wrongfully detained," making their release a top priority. The [USN:L1N44G127 TEXT:"other"] is Min Zin, a scholar arrested in June. Rong said she was told that Trump also would press Xi to release Zin. Trump raised Chen's case with Xi during a visit to Beijing in May, but it produced no action, Rong said. "Resolving the wrongful detentions of US citizens is always a top priority for the president," a senior US official said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive matters. The Chinese embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Chinese foreign ministry said in July that the country's judiciary deals with cases according to the law "and there is no so-called wrongful detention." 'BE STRONG' Chen, whose detention was [USN:L6N43F03L TEXT:"revealed"] by Reuters in July, is a seismologist with a US government contractor. His work detecting shockwaves from North Korean underground nuclear tests has been openly funded by the State Department and the US Air Force Research Laboratory. He became a US citizen in 2011 and settled in the Boston area. He was arrested by Chinese state security officers on November 5, 2024, at Beijing International Airport as he prepared to fly home after visiting family and lecturing at two universities. Rong said her husband had been interrogated more than 100 times. "I can't imagine how hard his life is there every day," she said. She believes that China wants to use her husband's expertise to improve its ability to conceal nuclear tests using decoupling, a technique in which a device is detonated inside a large underground chamber to reduce the size of the shockwaves. The US has [USN:L1N3ZD0Z2 TEXT:"accused"] China of using decoupling to try to mask a low-yield nuclear test blast on June 22, 2020. China, which like the US has signed but not ratified a 1996 international ban on nuclear tests, denies conducting the test. US embassy officials had been allowed to visit Chen for about 30 minutes once a month, always in the presence of Chinese officials, Rong said. They read out letters she had written to him and he dictated his replies. "They record his appearance, his mental status, and just anything that they observe," she recounted, adding that Chen's Chinese lawyer was not allowed to discuss his visits with her. Rong is concerned about the conditions of her husband's confinement, where she said he received substandard medical care and food. He suffered from high blood pressure and diabetes. Asked what she would say to her husband if she could see him, Rong replied: "'Be strong. Be optimistic. There are a lot of people helping you. You will come back for sure.'"

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝メッツ、グリーン監督と3年契約 千賀所属
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）で千賀滉大投手が所属するメッツは２２日、暫定監督を務めていたアンディ・グリーン氏（４９）と３年契約を結び、正式監督に昇格させた。

グリーン氏は６月２６日にカルロス・メンドサ前監督が解任された後、暫定監督に就任。レギュラーシーズン残り６試合の時点で、指揮を執った７５試合で３７勝３８敗としている。

メッツは今季、約３億５６００万ドル（約５６０億円）の総年俸を抱えながらナ・リーグ東地区最下位に低迷。４月には１２連敗を喫し、メンドサ前監督が解任された時点でも６連敗中で、成績は３４勝４７敗だった。

グリーン氏はニュースリリースを通じ、「暫定監督を引き受けた時は正式就任することになるとは思っていなかった。選手やスタッフと過ごす時間が増えるにつれ、自分の情熱と経験を最も生かせる場所だと明確になった」と述べた。

グリーン氏は２０１６─１９年にパドレスの監督を務め、２７４勝３６６敗の成績を残した。２０─２３年にはカブスでベンチコーチを務めた。

item.title: Ｆ１＝角田が再びリザーブへ、レッドブルでハジャー復帰に伴い
item.description: ［バクー ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［バクー　２２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のレーシングブルズで直近３戦に出場していた角田裕毅が、今週末のアゼルバイジャン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）から再びリザーブの役割に戻る見通しとなった。レッドブルが２２日、手首のけがで欠場していたアイザック・ハジャー（フランス）の復帰を発表した。

ハジャーはマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）とともにレッドブルから出場する。ハジャーの代役を務めていたリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）がレーシングブルズに戻るため、ローソンに代わって英国人ルーキーのアービッド・リンドブラッドと組んでいた角田はシートを譲る形となる。

ハジャーはオランダ、イタリア、スペインの各ＧＰを欠場。ローソンはその３戦のうち２戦で入賞した。

アゼルバイジャンＧＰは２４日にフリー走行が始まり、同国の戦没者を悼む「追悼の日」のため、決勝は通常の日曜日（２７日）ではなく土曜日（２６日）に行われる。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース、佐々木がＩＬから復帰 ウォードは中日へ
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースが、佐々木朗希投手（２４）とアンディ・パヘス外野手（２５）を負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）から復帰させた。

佐々木は８月２６日のブレーブス戦で右手中指にまめができて以降、登板していなかった。今季は２３試合全てに先発し、５勝５敗、防御率４．６０。デーブ・ロバーツ監督は、プレーオフで佐々木を救援で起用する見通しを示している。

パヘスは８月２１日のパイレーツ戦で相手投手の投球を左手に受けて以来、戦列を離れていた。今季は１２８試合に出場し、打率２割７分２厘、２１本塁打、８０打点を記録。今季初めてオールスターに選出された。

また複数の報道によると、ドジャースは同日、ライアン・ウォード外野手（２８）の契約をプロ野球・中日に譲渡した。マイナー生活が長かったウォードは今季メジャーデビューを果たし、２０試合で３本塁打。昨季はパシフィック・コースト・リーグ（ＰＣＬ）の最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれていたが、先週に事実上の戦力外となる措置を受けていた。

item.title: UK ready to lead global push on AI standards, Burnham tells UN
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the United Nations that Britain was ready to lead an international effort to establish AI standards, citing concerns that the technology could outpace safeguards and pose mounting national security risks.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Piper
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the United Nations that Britain was ready to lead an international effort to establish AI standards, citing concerns that the technology could outpace safeguards and pose mounting national security risks. "We've all [USN:L8N45D0T9 TEXT:"heard the warnings"] – which we must heed," he said in his inaugural speech to the United Nations General Assembly. "I know how worried people are. So we have to rise to this moment." At his first multinational meeting in New York as Britain's seventh prime minister in a decade, Burnham made his support for AI the focus of his bid for Britain to assume a role on the global stage, rebuilding its diplomatic status. He has said that rather than become a "[USN:L1N45D0WF TEXT:"doom-monger"]" about AI, he wanted Britain to pursue the huge benefits it could bring while being clear about the risks, which range from safeguards failing to keep up and hostile actors using it to wage an information war. "Russian agencies have used every means at their disposal to spread lies and disinformation and prey on people's fears," he said. "They've used bots and fake websites. Falsified newspaper articles. Forged the branding of 28 British organisations – including universities and the BBC. They've amplified far right narratives. And we have evidence that they tried to interfere with the 2019 General Election." Russia has rejected the allegations. Burnham said he would position Britain as an "honest broker" to take a leadership role, citing its close US ties, improving EU relationship and decent relations with China and India. Britain has a [USN:L8N45D0PM TEXT:"world-leading AI Security Institute"], which works hand in glove with the US and the leading labs on AI safety, he said, but it needed to go further. In [USN:L1N4590CK TEXT:"discussions with AI leaders"], officials have made clear Britain expects full and total visibility of new frontier models to strengthen the UK's preparedness and resilience, his office said. Burnham said fundamental decisions on AI had to be taken by elected governments, not left to tech companies, and he would put AI at the heart of Britain's presidency of the G20 next year. "We will work towards agreeing a single set of global principles and standards to ensure the transparency and access we need to increase our preparedness – and to ensure that AI development is safe," he said. Burnham announced a new National Centre for Information Defence to detect, attribute and disrupt hostile state information attacks and identify deepfakes damaging British interests. "Today I am tasking our security chiefs to begin work on a new National Centre for Information Defence – to detect, attribute and disrupt these kinds of hostile state information attacks – to support and defend our democracy," he said.

item.title: 高市首相、国連演説でＩＣＣに言及 国際情勢の緊迫化に「三つの柱」提唱
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[２３日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は２３日（現地時間２２日）、米ニューヨークの国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説に臨んだ。地政学的対立の先鋭化によって国際情勢が緊迫し、自由な交易やエネルギーの安定供給が脅かされているとし、日本が注力する三つの柱を提唱。国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）などを例に挙げ、国際裁判所と法の支配の重要性を一貫して支持する日本の姿勢をアピールした。

演説の中で高市氏はまず、世界各地で地政学的競争が激化し、日々罪のない市民が命を失っているとの問題意識を提示。「国際社会が新たな課題を乗り越えて繁栄する上で、今ほど、国連が重要な時代はない」と強調した。

その上で、安倍晋三元首相が提唱した「自由で開かれたインド太平洋（ＦＯＩＰ）」に言及。自由な交易が妨げられ、エネルギーの安定供給やサプライチェーン（供給網）に支障が生じているとし、「自らの運命を自らの手で決めるために必要な『自律性』と『強靱性』、これを経済・社会・安全保障という全ての面で各国が身につけていく」ため、三つの柱を掲げた。

一つ目は、エネルギー・重要物資のサプライチェーン強靱化だ。特定の国は名指しせず「国際社会全体で恣意的な輸出規制に対する懸念が強まっている」とし、日本の取り組みを紹介した。

二つ目は平和と安定に向けた連携強化。日本が戦後一貫して核軍縮・不拡散に真剣に取り組んできたとし、「『核兵器のない世界』に向けた国際社会の取り組みを主導するのは、唯一の戦争被爆国である我が国の使命だ」と強調。ロシアと北朝鮮の軍事協力の強化によって「核・ミサイル関連技術の拡散も懸念される」としつつ、北朝鮮による拉致問題の文脈では「互いに実りある関係を作るべく、私には、対話し、具体的に行動する用意がある」と呼びかけた。

三つ目に挙げたのは、法の支配に基づく自由で開かれた国際秩序の維持・発展への貢献だ。力や威圧による一方的な現状変更の試みは「世界のどこであっても認めることはできない」と強調した。ＩＣＣなどを例示し、「様々な国際裁判所を一貫して支持し、判事を輩出していること」が、法の支配を重視する日本の姿勢の表れだと訴える一方、米国から制裁対象とされた赤根智子ＩＣＣ所長の名前には触れなかった。イラン情勢も取り上げ、ホルムズ海峡の自由かつ安全な航行は「国際経済全体の安定のためにも極めて重要だ」と指摘した。

高市氏はこの他、気候変動対策の重要性に加え、第二次世界大戦の敗戦国を対象にした「旧敵国条項」の早急な削除を含む国連憲章の見直しや安全保障理事会の変革など、国連改革の必要性を訴えた。日本が国連と歩みを重ねる方針は今後も変わらないとし、「国連と共に、インド太平洋を、そして国際社会を、より強靱に豊かにして、平和と繁栄を創る決意だ」と述べた。

「旧敵国条項」を巡っては、高市氏が昨年１１月、台湾有事について国会で「存立危機事態になり得る」と答弁した後、中国がソーシャルメディア上で同条項は依然有効だと主張。今月にも同様の見解を示している。

演説に先立ち、高市氏はトランプ米大統領と会談した。会談の冒頭、高市氏は「日米間で経済安全保障の協力も進んでいる」など話した上で、「今日はたくさんのイシュー（重要な問題）をお話ししたい」と語っていた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：久保信博）

item.title: US warns Australia's social media algorithm reforms risk 'facilitating censorship'
item.description: SYDNEY, Sept 23 : The Trump administration has criticised Australia's proposed social media algorithm reforms, which would give users the option to choose the content on their feeds, warning that Washington would likely view them as "facilitating censorship".Under draft laws proposed this month by Australia's

US warns Australia's social media algorithm reforms risk 'facilitating censorship'

FILE PHOTO: People use their mobile phones, ahead of new law banning social media for users under 16 in Australia, at dusk in Brisbane, Australia, December 8, 2025. REUTERS/Hollie Adams/File Photo

SYDNEY, Sept 23 : The Trump administration has criticised Australia's proposed social media algorithm reforms, which would give users the option to choose the content on their feeds, warning that Washington would likely view them as "facilitating censorship". Under draft laws proposed this month by Australia's centre-left Labor government, social media platforms would be required to notify users and offer a default algorithm-recommended content feed, with the option to opt out and instead see posts only from accounts they choose to follow. In a formal submission to Australia's public consultation process, the US Embassy in Canberra said late on Tuesday it had "serious concerns" about the proposed law's goal of mandating how platforms manage content and user feeds. "We are particularly concerned by potential mandates that would allow regulators to impose rigid, one-size-fits-all platform design requirements - such as forced chronological feeds or opt-in recommendation systems," the statement said.

The US warned the proposed legislation could have implications beyond Australia's borders, saying the mandated algorithm design requirements "may affect what users see, say and hear not just in or from Australia, but globally."     Washington urged Canberra to clearly define how "harm" and "risk" would be determined, by whom, and against what standard, cautioning that vague definitions risk enabling viewpoint-based censorship by incentivising platforms to over-moderate protected speech to avoid regulatory penalties. Should Australia compel platforms to aggressively filter algorithmic content in ways that capture protected speech, the US warned, the suppression of a disfavoured speaker or media source's reach would be no different from outright removal. "The US government would likely consider such a measure as facilitating censorship," the statement said.     The comments come as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attends the United Nations General Assembly in New York, where he has been promoting his government's technology reform agenda and raising concerns about the risks posed by artificial intelligence. When asked by a reporter about the US criticism of the draft legislation, Albanese said the proposed measure was not intended to grant governments greater authority, but rather to restore individuals' control over their content choices, which was reflected in the way the policy has been framed. "I will always stand up for Australia's national interests, and the (reform) is something we have foreshadowed for some time," Albanese said. The Australian government is seeking feedback from digital platforms, industry bodies, civil society organisations and advocates on the draft "Digital Duty of Care" legislation, with the bill expected to be introduced to parliament this year.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Zelenskiy says Russia planning new mass attack on Ukraine
item.description: The president said Ukraine was in constant communication with its allies on securing new anti-aircraft defences.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Russia was planning a new major attack on his country, in comments published on Tuesday. Zelenskiy, posting on Telegram about his meeting with British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, said Ukraine was in constant communication with its allies on securing new anti-aircraft defences. "There's intelligence right now that Russia is preparing a new massive attack against Ukraine," Zelenskiy wrote. He said that there could not possibly be any discussion of easing sanctions against Russia "when Ukrainians live every day under the threat of missile and drone attacks". Russian forces have long unleashed large-scale overnight attacks by drones and missiles but have altered tactics in recent weeks, launching constant barrages throughout the day. Moscow also in recent months has [USN:L8N45D0YY TEXT:"deployed jet-powered drones,"] which fly at higher altitudes and evade air defences, disrupting businesses, government and ordinary life on a much bigger scale than previously in the 4-1/2-year-old war. While in New York, Zelenskiy [USN:L8N45E0JN TEXT:"discussed"] efforts to end the war with U.S. President Donald Trump, including a potential bilateral ceasefire on energy-related targets. Russian troops are advancing slowly through eastern Ukraine's Donetsk region but the front line has undergone little change in many months. Ukrainian forces now launch air strikes on Russian targets, many in the oil industry, at sites up to 3,000 km (1,800 miles) from the Ukrainian border. Interviewed in New York by the Wall Street Journal, Zelenskiy said Russian President Vladimir Putin was neither winning nor losing the war, but did not feel compelled to hold direct negotiations on ending the conflict. "The situation on the battlefield is not successful for Putin. He is not winning, it is true. And he is not losing, it is also true, because for him human losses are not to lose ... but his society is losing people," Zelenskiy said. "He doesn't feel that he has to stop."

LONDON, Sept 23 : WPP opened a production facility in London on Wednesday which the British company said was the first of a global roll-out to meet demand for high-quality ads that can be deployed across social media and other platforms at speed. Cindy Rose, WPP's CEO for the past year, brought together its production capabilities in WPP Production, one of four operating units, early in 2026 as part of her turnaround plan. WPP's clients, who include Coca-Cola, Unilever and Ford, needed to influence consumers through hyper-local, community-led engagement at scale, while also impacting algorithms so they could be discovered by AI chatbots and other services, she said. The 34,000-square-foot Devon's Point hub, in East London, would help address this need, Rose said, with rapid shooting and editing facilities, advanced AI production and creator collaboration spaces.
